name: Employees
overview: Scripture instructs both employees and employers to conduct their relationships with integrity and reverence for God. Employees are called to obey their earthly masters sincerely, as if serving Christ Himself, while employers are commanded to treat their servants justly and without threats, recognizing that they too have a Master in heaven. The Bible condemns defrauding or withholding wages and emphasizes that all work should be done wholeheartedly, as service to the Lord rather than to men.
